surface-card.$description: Warm card fill: raised paper, one step lighter than the parchment ground.

surface-inset.$description: Warm recessed surface: wells and tracks.

ground.$description: The page ground under raised cards, the lowest of three surface levels (ground < inset < raised in lightness, all themes). warm: #e3dbcf ground (warm line: the warm page bg #f6f1e8 is lighter than warm inset, so it would break the order), #fbfaf7 raised. Added 2026-10-03 for the portfolio layout (Gate 2).

usage: The page behind raised cards in a three-level layout
Not the default page: that stays background
dont: Do not put muted text on ground in light or warm: 6.80:1 and 6.72:1 are AA, not AAA; put meta on raised, or use ink
Do not use it for strokes: that is border

raised.$description: A raised card on the ground, the highest of three surface levels: always lighter than inset and ground, also in dark, so cards never read as holes. warm: #fbfaf7 raised. Added 2026-10-03.

usage: Cards and panels that sit on ground
dont: Do not put it on the plain page background in light: both are white there

text-secondary.$description: Warm secondary text, AAA on every warm surface.

text-muted.$description: Warm muted text, AAA on every warm surface.

accent-border.$description: Warm control-weight edge for a selected item.

border-faint.$description: Warm hairline card edge, decorative only.

border-strong.$description: Warm control border, 3:1 on every warm surface.

$description: Warm theme ([data-theme="warm"], 2026-10-03, Elleta): overrides on top of semantic/light.json. Parchment ground, raised paper cards, warm muted and control. Ochre stays the one accent fill and ochre-deep the focus ring; everything not listed here is the light value.
